+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_user_initials(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    words = user["name"].split()
+    initials = words[0][0].upper()
+    if len(words) > 1:
+        initials += words[-1][0].upper()
+    return 200, {"initials": initials}

+from app.api.handlers import handle_get_user, handle_user_initials
+
+
+def test_get_user_ok():
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"id": 1, "name": "Ada Lovelace", "email": "ada@example.com"})
+
+
+def test_get_user_invalid():
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "abc"})[0] == 400
+
+
+def test_get_user_missing():
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "99"})[0] == 404
+
+
+def test_user_initials_ok():
+    assert handle_user_initials({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"initials": "AL"})
+    assert handle_user_initials({"id": "2"}) == (200, {"initials": "LT"})
+    assert handle_user_initials({"id": "3"}) == (200, {"initials": "GH"})
+
+
+def test_user_initials_single_word(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "app.api.handlers.users.get_user",
+        lambda user_id: {"id": user_id, "name": "Cher", "email": "cher@example.com"},
+    )
+    assert handle_user_initials({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"initials": "C"})
+
+
+def test_user_initials_invalid():
+    assert handle_user_initials({"id": "abc"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+    assert handle_user_initials({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+    assert handle_user_initials({"id": 1}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_user_initials_missing():
+    assert handle_user_initials({"id": "99"}) == (404, {"error": "not found"})
